summary: Completed backend+frontend live testing for media storage integration using public preview URL. Real managed storage upload/download worked with byte/hash verification for synthetic WAV/MP3/TXT/JSON/CSV fixtures; permissions, metadata, assessments, archival, and requested regressions were executed.

critical.issue: Idempotency key replay with different request body returns 422 instead of expected conflict 409.

action_items: Map idempotency-body mismatch in /api/media/uploads to HTTP 409 conflict (current broad ValueError handling emits 422).
Re-run media live suite after status-code correction.
critical_code_review_comments: In media router prepare(), ValueError from store.replay() is grouped with format validation and converted to 422, which masks idempotency conflict semantics.
Public response sanitization is correctly applied for media file envelopes (storage_path/upload_token not exposed).

Required desktop/mobile screenshots captured at /app/test_reports/screenshots/iteration_71_ui/work_media_desktop_1920x800.jpeg and /app/test_reports/screenshots/iteration_71_ui/work_media_mobile_390x844.jpeg. rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/media/uploads with a fresh idempotency key succeeds; replay same key with changed filename/body returns 422. Root cause: routers/media_library.py prepare() catches ValueError from both formats.describe() and store.replay() in one block and always raises HTTPException(422). Idempotency mismatch from store.replay() should be differentiated and mapped to conflict 409.
